subject.title: Feature: Add maxTurns/maxToolCalls config option to limit agent iterations

question: Should OpenClaw standardize the active PR's iteration-round budget, force-summary option, and fail-closed harness support as the public agent safety contract, or narrow those semantics before refreshing the branch?
rationale: The missing guard and a viable implementation are proven, but the config/API names, what counts as an iteration, unsupported-harness behavior, and user-visible exhaustion result are durable product and compatibility choices.

options.title: Refine and refresh current PR
options.body: Approve the core direction, settle the public contract, then update the active implementation onto current main for full review.

options.title: Narrow the first release
options.body: Ship one opt-in hard tool-round or tool-call counter without force-summary or broad harness API expansion, then add richer policy later.

options.title: Keep heuristic controls only
options.body: Decline a hard budget and continue relying on loop detection plus whole-run timeouts despite the documented unbounded cases.

recommendation.title: Refine and refresh current PR
recommendation.body: Approve the core direction, settle the public contract, then update the active implementation onto current main for full review.
